# Hey, I'm Anuhas 👋

Software engineer building **AI-native products, agent systems, and production full-stack applications**.

I work across the TypeScript ecosystem, combining software engineering, applied AI, and product thinking to take ideas from early prototypes to systems people can actually use.

Based in Colombo, Sri Lanka 🇱🇰

### What I'm into

- Building AI-native SaaS products and agentic workflows
- Full-stack product engineering with Next.js and TypeScript
- Multi-agent systems, tool use, retrieval, and AI infrastructure
- Backend architecture, authentication, payments, and event-driven systems
- Product design, developer experience, and shipping useful software
- Exploring better ways to build software with AI coding agents

### Beyond the code

I'm interested in the full product lifecycle, not just implementation.

That means understanding the problem, designing the experience, making architecture decisions, building the system, shipping it, and learning from what happens next.

I also write about software, AI, products, experiments, and things I learn while building.
